subject: Inquiry about RTX 1650 GPU Support for Amber Simulations

messages.author: Muhammad Tariq
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I am writing to inquire about the compatibility of the RTX 1650 graphics processing unit (GPU) with Amber for running simulations.
I am interested in using Amber for simulations and would like to know if the RTX 1650 GPU is a supported option for accelerating these calculations.
If the RTX 1650 is no longer supported, could you please advise on alternative GPUs that are compatible with Amber?
Thank you for your time and assistance.
Sincerely,
Muhammad Tariq
